name: weather
description: Get current weather information for any city. Demonstrates the JARVIS plugin system with mock data.
author: JARVIS Team

commands.name: get_weather
commands.description: Get the current weather for a specified city. Returns temperature, conditions, humidity, and wind speed.

city.description: The city name to get weather for, e.g. 'Beijing', 'London', 'Tokyo'

config.label: Default City
config.description: Default city used when no city is specified.
